2) the a-c-t-o-r i-m-p-o-s-t-e-r-e-d the b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c s-c-a-n n-a-m-e and left a f-a-l-s-e e-n-r-o-l-l log while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y c-o-n-f-i-r-m

4) the a-c-t-o-r e-d-i-t-e-d the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g t-i-m-e s-t-a-m-p and left a d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-h-a-n-g-e h-e-s-t
5) the a-c-t-o-r r-u-n n-i-n-g the r-i-v-e-r s-i-d-e p-a-t-h b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c f-a-l-s-e d-a-t-a and left a s-c-r-e-e-n-s-h-o-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the h-a-s-h v-e-r-i-f-y
